doc.name: Wellspent advisor finder
doc.description: Finds fee-only financial advisors in the US and Canada for a plain-language request, from Wellspent's public graph.

skills.name: Find fee-only advisors
skills.description: Given a location and need (e.g. "fee-only advisor in Austin who knows equity compensation"), returns ranked advisors with why each fits and their profile links.
